phonics.title: The Dentist
phonics.text: Sam had a bad tooth. He went to the dentist. She had a look, then she handed Sam a red toothbrush. Now Sam will brush his teeth with the toothbrush a lot.

questions.question: Who did Sam go to see?
What did the dentist give Sam?
Why did Sam go to the dentist?

phonics.reason: Removed 'got Sam' (odd for a dentist), unexplained 'Sam was sad', and the tense jump to 'will'.

phonics.title: The Rocket
phonics.text: Josh and Jess had a box at the picnic. It was a rocket! They painted it red and stuck a flag on top. It was not big, but Gran said it was the best rocket at the picnic. Josh and Jess sat on the blanket with big smiles.

questions.question: What did Josh and Jess paint red?
What did they stick on top?
Why did Josh and Jess have big smiles?
questions.answer: Gran said it was the best rocket.

phonics.reason: 'Had a rocket' then 'painted it' did not make sense; now a box becomes a rocket.

phonics.title: The Hamster
phonics.text: Nan's hamster got out. It was not in its box. Nan looked in the basket and in her jacket. Then she felt a bump in her pocket. It was the hamster!

questions.question: Whose hamster got out?
Where did Nan find the hamster?
Why did Nan look in the basket and in her jacket?
questions.answer: She was looking for the hamster / it had got out.

phonics.title: The Bird
phonics.text: A bird sat on the ground. It had a hurt wing. A boy found it. He called Gran and they got a box for it. Soon the bird was well and flew away.

questions.question: What was wrong with the bird?
Who found the bird?
Why did the boy call Gran?
questions.answer: To help the bird (it was hurt).

phonics.reason: Box now has a purpose ('for it').

phonics.title: The Bike
phonics.text: Pat rode her bike to the shop. She left it next to the gate. When she came back, the bike was on the ground. The wind had pushed it down. Pat picked it up and rode home.

questions.question: What did Pat ride?
Where did Pat leave her bike?
Why was the bike on the ground?

phonics.reason: 'Made it drop' is not what wind does to a bike.

phonics.title: The Snow
phonics.text: It was very cold and snow fell all day. Kim and her friends made a big snowman. Next day the sun came out and it got warm. The snowman melted.

questions.question: What did Kim and her friends make?
When did the snowman melt?
Why did the snowman melt?
questions.answer: It got warm / the sun came out.

phonics.reason: Cold day to 'hot' was a jump; the melt now follows the next day.

phonics.title: The Rope
phonics.text: Cindy went to the gym with her friends. She wanted to go up the rope. It was hard at first. Cindy kept trying and got to the top. Her friends were proud.

questions.question: Where did Cindy go?
What did Cindy want to go up?
Why were her friends proud?
questions.answer: She kept trying and got to the top.

phonics.reason: Friends appeared from nowhere; now they come to the gym.

phonics.title: Mr Cole
phonics.text: Mr Cole was old and kind. Each day he fed the birds in the park. One day he was ill and could not come. The birds were hungry. They waited and waited for Mr Cole.

questions.question: Who fed the birds?
Where did he feed the birds?
Why were the birds hungry?
questions.answer: Mr Cole was ill and did not come.

phonics.title: The Present
phonics.text: Wes wrapped a book for his gran. He wrote a note on it and tied a knot in the string. Gran was so pleased.

questions.question: Who did Wes wrap a book for?
What did Wes tie a knot in?
Why was Gran pleased?
questions.answer: She got a book from Wes.

phonics.reason: Wrapping a note as a present was odd; now a wrapped book with a note.

phonics.title: The Match
phonics.text: Mitch had a football match. Dad came to watch. Mitch was in goal. A big kick sent the ball at him. Mitch jumped and caught it! Dad shouted with joy.

questions.question: Where was Mitch in the match?
What did Mitch catch?
Why did Dad shout with joy?
questions.answer: Mitch caught the ball / saved a goal.

phonics.reason: Went to a match then was in goal; 'a kick came at him' fixed.

phonics.title: The Bridge
phonics.text: Bridget stood on the bridge and looked down. The river was far below. Her knees did not shake. She held the rail and looked for a fish.

questions.question: Where did Bridget stand?
What was far below?
Why did Bridget hold the rail?

phonics.reason: Removed unsafe leaning out over the rail.

phonics.title: The Pet Lamb
phonics.text: Nick has a pet lamb. It follows him to the school gate. The lamb waits there till home time. Then the lamb follows Nick back to the farm.

questions.question: What is Nick's pet?
Where does the lamb wait?
Why does the lamb wait till home time?
questions.answer: Nick is at school / it wants to go home with him.

report: Patterns: wrong verbs ('had a rocket then painted it', 'made it drop', 'dropped'), tense jumps (isn't, feeds/was), unexplained sad/friends, unsafe or odd actions (lean over rail, wrap a note, butt a knee), cold-to-hot jump. Left alone: 6-1,6-2,6-5,7-0,7-2,7-3,7-4,7-5,8-0,8-1,8-2,8-4,8-5,9-1,9-3,9-4,10-4,10-5 which read naturally. 6-5 'put' and 8-3 'over/blown/knocked' were not decodable so alternatives chosen.
